title: Padar zinda hai akbar
body:
Haye,  haye..
Padar zinda hai akbar..(2)
<<MINI>>
tum hogaye bejaan, padar zinda hai akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisa bhi zamane mein kahi'n hota hai akbar
<<MINI>>
tum hogaye bejaan, padar zinda hai akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Maqtal se janaze ko tere kaise uthayein
jin haatho'n se mangi tere jeene ki duaein
un haatho'n pe ab haaye tera laasha hai akbar
<<MINI>>
tum hogaye bejaan, padar zinda hai akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Dil apna sambhalu'n to sina dil se nikalu phir kaampte haatho'n se tera laasha uthalu
kis haal mein dekho to tera baba hai akbar
<<MINI>>
tum hogaye bejaan, padar zinda hai akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tum aankhein phira lete ho jab dard ke maare
jab saans nahi lete ho haatho'n pe hamare
dum saath mein mera bhi nikal jaata hai akbar
<<MINI>>
tum hogaye bejaan, padar zinda hai akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Socha tha tumhe shaan se hum dulha banate..(2)
afsos magar laash pe hain aansoo bahate
ab khoon ka maathe pe tere sehra hai akbar
<<MINI>>
tum hogaye bejaan, padar zinda hai akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Chut ta hai zaeefi mein jo bete ka sahara
ab saath nahi deti hai beenayi hamara
uth-ta hai padar aur kabhi girta hai akbar
<<MINI>>
tum hogaye bejaan, padar zinda hai akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Zainab ko tera haal ye dikhlau to kaise
mai apne gale se tujhe liptau to kaise
lipta hua barchi mein tera seena hai akbar
<<MINI>>
tum hogaye bejaan, padar zinda hai akbar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Nauha Ali akbar ka hai meesum ki zabani
aakho'n se raza hoti hai ashko ki rawani
ehsaas tere ghum ka badha jaata hai akbar
<<MINI>>
tum hogaye bejaan, padar zinda hai akbar..(2)
